theorems.name: Submission.lpf_rsn_null_diff_support_of_local_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), M ⊆ U → (∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → μ (M ∩ W) = 0) → μ (M \ T.support) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
